absent: How trap group masks combine with architectural fine grained trap registers and how nmask interacts with mask.
Allocation lifetime and locking for sysreg_masks and nested_mmus and pmu_filter and smccc_filter beyond config_lock and mp_state_lock.
Initialization sequence that sets ID_REGS_INITIALIZED and FGU_INITIALIZED and populates id_regs and fgu.
World switch flow that consumes fp_owner and debug_owner and sys_regs and vncr_array.
Semantics of steal base and last_steal and vsesr_el2 restoration timing.
Selection rule inside CHOOSE_NVHE_SYM and differences between protected and non protected instances.
Consumers and producers of vgic_v5_ppi_state bitmaps and trfcr_while_in_guest.

findings.text: Virtual machine record kvm_arch holds mmu plus fgu plus nested_mmus plus nested_mmus_size plus nested_mmus_next plus vgic plus timer_data plus psci_version plus config_lock plus flags plus vcpu_features plus mpidr_data plus pmu_filter plus arm_pmu plus supported_cpus plus nr_pmu_counters plus pmmir_slots plus smccc_feat plus smccc_filter plus id_regs plus midr_el1 plus revidr_el1 plus aidr_el1 plus ctr_el0 plus sysreg_masks plus vncr_tlb_count plus pkvm plus optional debug entry.

Twelve virtual machine flag positions are fixed with KVM_ARCH_FLAG_RETURN_NISV_IO_ABORT_TO_USER at bit zero plus KVM_ARCH_FLAG_MTE_ENABLED at bit one plus KVM_ARCH_FLAG_HAS_RAN_ONCE at bit two plus KVM_ARCH_FLAG_VCPU_FEATURES_CONFIGURED at bit three plus KVM_ARCH_FLAG_SYSTEM_SUSPEND_ENABLED at bit four plus KVM_ARCH_FLAG_VM_COUNTER_OFFSET at bit five plus KVM_ARCH_FLAG_TIMER_PPIS_IMMUTABLE at bit six plus KVM_ARCH_FLAG_ID_REGS_INITIALIZED at bit seven plus KVM_ARCH_FLAG_FGU_INITIALIZED at bit eight plus KVM_ARCH_FLAG_GUEST_HAS_SVE at bit nine plus KVM_ARCH_FLAG_WRITABLE_IMP_ID_REGS at bit ten plus KVM_ARCH_FLAG_EXIT_SEA at bit eleven.

Configuration mutex config_lock serializes virtual machine scoped configuration updates and provides atomicity for multi register accesses to emulated identification state which is stored per virtual machine yet touched from virtual cpu context.

Fine grained undef array fgu is tracked globally with identical feature presentation to every virtual cpu and entry zero reserved as spare. Emulated identification array id_regs is virtual machine wide with one slot per encodable identification register and concurrent multi slot updates require holding configuration mutex.

Identification index helper IDREG_IDX derives a compact slot from the CRm field minus one shifted by three combined with the Op2 field. Total slot count KVM_ARM_ID_REG_NUM equals the index of the encoding with operation zero three and operation one zero and CRn zero and CRm seven and Op2 seven plus one, covering CRm one through seven with Op2 zero through seven.

Trap group enumeration starts with __NO_FGT_GROUP__ then HFGRTR_GROUP plus HFGWTR_GROUP aliased to the read group plus HDFGRTR_GROUP plus HDFGWTR_GROUP aliased to its read group plus HFGITR_GROUP plus HAFGRTR_GROUP plus HFGRTR2_GROUP plus HFGWTR2_GROUP aliased plus HDFGRTR2_GROUP plus HDFGWTR2_GROUP aliased plus HFGITR2_GROUP plus ICH_HFGRTR_GROUP plus ICH_HFGWTR_GROUP aliased plus ICH_HFGITR_GROUP with __NR_FGT_GROUP_IDS__ required last as count.
Fault record kvm_vcpu_fault_info carries esr_el2 plus far_el2 plus hpfar_el2 plus disr_el1 capturing syndrome plus fault address plus intermediate physical fault address plus deferred status.

System register enumeration vcpu_sysreg reserves value zero as __INVALID_SYSREG__ then orders general controls such as MPIDR_EL1 plus CLIDR_EL1 plus CNTKCTL_EL1 plus PAR_EL1 plus performance registers from PMCR_EL0 through PMEVCNTR0_EL0 to counter thirty and PMEVTYPER0_EL0 to type thirty plus authentication keys APIAKEYLO_EL1 through APGAKEYHI_EL1 in strict increase plus tagging registers RGSR_EL1 plus GCR_EL1 plus TFSRE0_EL1 plus overlay POR_EL0 plus SVCR plus FPMR plus 32bit traps plus EL2 controls plus marker __SANITISED_REG_START__ plus marker __VNCR_START__ with virtualized controls after the latter and NR_SYS_REGS terminating.

Helper __MAX__ selects the larger of two values with xor masking rather than branching. Helper VNCR assigns each virtualized register an enumeration slot equal to a common VNCR base plus its byte offset divided by eight, bracketed by before and after sentinels where the after value keeps the maximum of predecessor minus one and the new slot.

Sanitization pair resx holds res0 plus res1. Mask table kvm_sysreg_masks holds one pair per sanitizable register sized from __SANITISED_REG_START__ to NR_SYS_REGS. Descriptor fgt_masks holds str plus mask plus nmask plus res0 plus res1 for trap group filtering.

Getter returns an empty pair when mask storage is absent or when the requested register lies outside the sanitised interval, otherwise it returns the stored pair for that slot. Setter writes the supplied pair directly into the slot without presence or range validation. Convenience macros forward a virtual machine pointer to the arch scoped helpers.

Inline helpers __kvm_get_sysreg_resx plus kvm_get_sysreg_resx plus __kvm_set_sysreg_resx plus kvm_set_sysreg_resx form the callable interface for reading and installing reserved bit masks for sanitizable and virtualized system registers.

Cpu context kvm_cpu_context holds general registers regs plus abort status spsr_abt plus undef status spsr_und plus irq status spsr_irq plus fiq status spsr_fiq plus floating state fp_regs plus system array sys_regs sized by NR_SYS_REGS plus running pointer __hyp_running_vcpu plus vncr_array which must remain four kilobyte aligned.

Host per cpu record kvm_host_data holds flags plus host_ctxt plus sve_regs plus fp_owner plus host_debug_state plus trfcr_while_in_guest plus nr_event_counters plus debug_brps plus debug_wrps plus last_lr_irq plus vgic_v5_ppi_state.

Seven host flag positions are fixed with KVM_HOST_DATA_FLAG_HAS_SPE at bit zero plus KVM_HOST_DATA_FLAG_HAS_TRBE at bit one plus KVM_HOST_DATA_FLAG_TRBE_ENABLED at bit two plus KVM_HOST_DATA_FLAG_EL1_TRACING_CONFIGURED at bit three plus KVM_HOST_DATA_FLAG_VCPU_IN_HYP_CONTEXT at bit four plus KVM_HOST_DATA_FLAG_L1_VNCR_MAPPED at bit five plus KVM_HOST_DATA_FLAG_HAS_BRBE at bit six.

Floating ownership fp_owner cycles among FP_STATE_FREE plus FP_STATE_HOST_OWNED plus FP_STATE_GUEST_OWNED indicating whether vector state is unclaimed or held by host or by guest across world switches.

Host debug save area keeps guest debug registers regs plus profiling controls pmscr_el1 plus pmblimitr_el1 plus trace controls trfcr_el1 plus trblimitr_el1 plus trap snapshots mdcr_el2 plus branch control brbcr_el1. Private interrupt tracker keeps pending bitmap pendr plus exit active bitmap activer_exit. Firmware record keeps version plus smccc_version plus function_ids_0_1 plus psci_0_1_cpu_suspend_implemented plus psci_0_1_cpu_on_implemented plus psci_0_1_cpu_off_implemented plus psci_0_1_migrate_implemented.
Symbols kvm_host_psci_config plus hyp_physvirt_offset plus hyp_cpu_logical_map resolve through selector CHOOSE_NVHE_SYM so that each name maps to the appropriate hypervisor resident instance.

Reset request vcpu_reset_state carries pc plus r0 plus be plus reset. Virtual cpu record kvm_vcpu_arch carries ctxt plus sve_state plus fp_type plus sve_max_vl plus hw_mmu plus hcr_el2 plus hcrx_el2 plus mdcr_el2 plus fgt plus fault plus cflags plus iflags plus sflags plus pause plus vcpu_debug_state plus external_debug_state plus external_mdscr_el1 plus debug_owner plus vgic_cpu plus timer_cpu plus pmu plus mp_state plus mp_state_lock plus mmu_page_cache plus pkvm_memcache plus vsesr_el2 plus reset_state plus steal plus ccsidr plus vncr_tlb plus pid with fgt offering r plus w per trap group and steal offering last_steal plus base.

Spinlock mp_state_lock guards power state mp_state. Configuration flag updates bracket read modify write with a preemption guard which is empty in one build variant and disables preemption in the other, preventing migration during multi bit clear then set sequences.
Debug ownership debug_owner moves among VCPU_DEBUG_FREE plus VCPU_DEBUG_HOST_OWNED plus VCPU_DEBUG_GUEST_OWNED separating host driven guest debugging from guest self debugging across world switches.

Flag descriptors encode a set name plus value plus mask triple. Singletons pair one bit as both value and mask. Accessors read once and mask for get, clear mask then set value for multi bit set, clear mask for clear, and get followed by clear for test and clear. Compile checks enforce mask weight consistency and fit within the storage width.
Public flag helpers expose unpack_vcpu_flag plus vcpu_test_and_clear_flag plus __vcpu_single_flag plus __vcpu_except_flags for building portable flag descriptors without touching storage directly.

Configuration bits fix VCPU_INITIALIZED at bit zero plus VCPU_SVE_FINALIZED at bit one plus VCPU_PKVM_FINALIZED at bit two. Input bits fix PENDING_EXCEPTION at bit zero plus INCREMENT_PC at bit one plus EXCEPT_MASK covering bits one through three plus PKVM_HOST_STATE_DIRTY at bit four. State bits fix ON_UNSUPPORTED_CPU at bit zero plus IN_WFIT at bit one plus SYSREGS_ON_CPU at bit two. Exception payloads encode AA32 UND zero plus IABT one plus DABT two and EL1 SYNC zero plus IRQ one plus FIQ two plus SERR three and EL2 SYNC four plus IRQ five plus FIQ six plus SERR seven shifted by the mask shift.

Setter for reserved masks dereferences mask storage unconditionally while getter tolerates absence, so uninitialized storage faults on write but not read. Pause flag lives outside virtual cpu context and races with flag words unless made atomic. Multi bit flag set clears the whole mask before setting, clobbering concurrent bits without the preemption guard. Virtual control array requires four kilobyte alignment and out of range sanitised lookups silently yield empty pairs.
